source.scope: Original full 0x4aecb0 rider control flow with real directional selection, high stance pose, ordinary pose and blend. Queries and nearby/trick transitions are recording adapters, and orientation reset is recorded with its original flag clear retained. Checks early exits, ordered input calls, dispatch index and pose/blend state. Graph/animation transitions and device responses have separate validations; this run does not prove their full rider integration or whole-bike parity.
